brandBody: See balances and entries from your Indian and US banks side by side, each in its own currency.
signInDescription: Sign in to Horizon to see your bank accounts and balances in one place.
signUpDescription: Create a Horizon account and add your first bank in minutes.
introAddBank: Add a bank now, or skip this and add one later from the menu.
introSignUp: We need a few details to set up your account. Nothing is shared with any bank until you add one.
introSignIn: Enter your email and password to see your accounts.
termsBefore: I am 18 or older and I agree to the

errorPostalCode: Enter a valid PIN or ZIP code.
errorDobFormat: Write the date as YYYY-MM-DD, for example 1990-04-23.
errorDobPast: Enter a real date in the past.
errorTaxId: Enter at least the last 4 digits.
errorPasswordsDiffer: The two passwords do not match.
errorCheckDetails: Check the details and try again.
errorTooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errorSignUp: We could not create your account. Check the details and try again.
passwordCommon: That password is too common. Choose another.
passwordHasEmail: Do not use your email in your password.
countryHint: We only ask for what your country needs.
usOnlyNote: Because you live in the US, our payment partner needs your date of birth and SSN to open your account. Horizon passes them on and does not keep them.
